name: A Life in the Making
thesis: A purple-black personal publication opens with monumental serif lettering layered around the real Monstrosity assembly, then unfolds into an intimate first-person letter with an active margin and an oversized machine folio.
interaction: Inline footnotes open résumé annotations in the letter’s margin, with native disclosure controls for each note. Selecting SERV0, DAVID, or Monstrosity changes the full-size artifact, project description, factual record, and source link.
why: Extends the intimate letter with a dramatic type-and-machine cover, midnight purple color, and an intentional reading path. Student makerspace responsibility, safety teaching, VEX shop leadership, Svelte/TypeScript, Stardance contributions, and Outpost peer support make the person as present as the printers.
